entities.summary: Adrian Israel Gurvitz is an English singer, songwriter, musician and record producer. His prolific songwriting ability has gained him hits with Eddie Money's No. 1 Billboard Mainstream Rock hit "The Love in Your Eyes" and with his own song "Classic", a No. 8 UK hit single, as well as the top 10 UK Rock Chart single "Race with the Devil", with his band the Gun. He also co-wrote the track "Even If My Heart Would Break" from the Grammy Award-winning soundtrack The Bodyguard. His early bands the Gun, Three Man Army and the Baker Gurvitz Army were major influences to the first wave of the British hard rock circuit.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a songwriter and musician, Adrian Gurvitz's work with bands like the Gun and Baker Gurvitz Army contributed to the development of the British hard rock circuit in the 1970s, influencing several notable artists. His songwriting credits on tracks like 'The Love in Your Eyes' and 'Even If My Heart Would Break' have had a lasting impact on popular music.
